query:
UPDATE org_idp_domains AS d
            SET deleted_at = now()
            FROM org_idps AS i
            WHERE d.org_idp_id = i.id
              AND i.org_id = $1
              AND d.org_idp_id = $2
              AND d.id = $3
              AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND i.deleted_at IS NULL
            RETURNING d.domain
